de: Beobachten Sie die Züge an der Dawlish Sea Wall, einer der spektakulärsten Bahnstrecken Englands.
Halten Sie Ausschau nach den berühmten schwarzen Schwänen, die im Flusslauf "Dawlish Water" schwimmen.
Im Sommer sind die Parkplätze am Strand schnell belegt; reisen Sie am besten bequem mit dem Zug an.
Der South West Coast Path bietet atemberaubende Ausblicke in Richtung Teignmouth.
hu: Figyeld meg a vonatokat a Dawlish Sea Wall mentén, ez Anglia egyik leglátványosabb vasútvonala.
Keresd a híres fekete hattyúkat, amik a Dawlish Water patakban úszkálnak.
Nyáron a tengerparti parkolók gyorsan megtelnek; a legkényelmesebb, ha vonattal érkezel.
Sétálj egyet a South West Coast Path-on, ahonnan csodás kilátás nyílik Teignmouth felé.
ro: Urmăriți trenurile de-a lungul Dawlish Sea Wall, una dintre cele mai spectaculoase rute feroviare din Anglia.
Căutați celebrele lebede negre care înoată în pârâul Dawlish Water.
Vara, parcările de lângă plajă se ocupă rapid; luați în considerare sosirea cu trenul pentru confort.
Cărarea South West Coast Path oferă priveliști uimitoare spre Teignmouth.
en: Watch the trains along the Dawlish Sea Wall, one of England's most scenic railway routes.
Look out for the famous black swans swimming in the Dawlish Water stream.
Beachfront parking fills up quickly in the summer; consider arriving by train for an easy trip.
The South West Coast Path offers stunning views towards Teignmouth.
